name: morphe
description: Bring your organization’s expert knowledge, and the work of capturing it, into your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Morphe captures what your experts know, through voice conversations with an AI interviewer, and turns it into living knowledge bases your organization keeps when they move on. This server brings Morphe into your AI assistant: ask questions and get answers grounded in what your experts actually said, with every answer citing the chapter and section it came from.

The server gives read-only access to one organization’s knowledge bases, the capture plans behind them (what each expert is covering and how far along they are), and the transcripts of every session. It also flags what isn’t documented yet, so your assistant tells you what it doesn’t know instead of guessing.

Access is scoped to the organization you approve at sign-in.
defaultPrompt: What knowledge bases do we have in Morphe?
Which experts' capture plans are at risk of not finishing before they leave?
Search our Morphe knowledge bases for how we handle a planned maintenance shutdown.

positive.description: Lists the knowledge bases of the connected organization.
positive.prompt: What knowledge bases do we have in Morphe?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected organization and lists its knowledge bases with how many chapters each holds.

positive.description: Summarizes one knowledge base from its outline.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of what the first Morphe knowledge base covers.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the knowledge base chapter by chapter from the outline's chapter summaries, without inventing chapters.

positive.description: Answers a question from the knowledge base, with citations.
positive.prompt: According to our experts in Morphe, how do we handle a planned maintenance shutdown?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers only from the sections it found or read and cites them as « Chapter title › Section heading »; says so when nothing in the knowledge base covers the question.

positive.prompt: Which experts' capture plans are at risk of not finishing before they leave?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the late plans first, then by departure date, with each plan's expert, departure date, progress percentage and status.

positive.description: Drills into one plan's open topics and a session transcript.
positive.prompt: For the most at-risk capture plan in Morphe, which topics are still not covered, and what was discussed in its most recent completed session?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the plan's pending and in-progress topics, then summarizes the latest completed session from its transcript, quoting the expert where useful.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the organization's experts.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Coding task with no link to Morphe.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

negative.description: Request to change data; Morphe is read-only and has no write tools.
negative.prompt: Delete the maintenance chapter from our Morphe knowledge base.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to knowledge bases and capture plans.

fr-FR.subtitle: Le savoir de vos experts
fr-FR.description:
Morphe recueille ce que savent vos experts, au fil de conversations vocales avec un intervieweur IA, et en fait des bases de connaissances vivantes que votre organisation conserve après leur départ. Ce serveur amène Morphe dans votre assistant IA : posez vos questions et obtenez des réponses fondées sur ce que vos experts ont réellement dit, chaque réponse citant le chapitre et la section d’où elle vient.

Le serveur donne un accès en lecture seule aux bases de connaissances d’une organisation, aux plans de captation qui les sous-tendent (ce que couvre chaque expert et où il en est) et aux transcriptions de chaque séance. Il signale aussi ce qui n’est pas encore documenté, pour que votre assistant vous dise ce qu’il ne sait pas au lieu de deviner.

L’accès est limité à l’organisation que vous approuvez à la connexion.
